content.text:
I made four small, targeted improvements to `0.html`:

1. Added `robots` meta so search engines are explicitly told to index/follow.
2. Added `og:image:width`/`og:image:height` so social previews render without a layout flash.
3. Added `text-decoration-skip-ink: auto` for cleaner underlines through descenders.
4. Added a print rule that appends visible URLs after external links (useful since printed pages lose hyperlinks).

The page was already in great shape (skip link, dark mode, focus styles, safe-area insets, reduced-motion handling) — these are incremental polish rather than a rewrite.

result:
I made four small, targeted improvements to `0.html`:

1. Added `robots` meta so search engines are explicitly told to index/follow.
2. Added `og:image:width`/`og:image:height` so social previews render without a layout flash.
3. Added `text-decoration-skip-ink: auto` for cleaner underlines through descenders.
4. Added a print rule that appends visible URLs after external links (useful since printed pages lose hyperlinks).

The page was already in great shape (skip link, dark mode, focus styles, safe-area insets, reduced-motion handling) — these are incremental polish rather than a rewrite.
